## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Unit tests cover changed behavior, or the PR explains why they cannot.
- [ ] `xcodebuild ... CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test` passes locally.
- [ ] User-facing text is covered in English and Simplified Chinese.
- [ ] `project.yml` and the checked-in Xcode project are in sync.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, signing material, private logs, or generated release artifacts are included.
